To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coupling coefficient has a large effect on the efficiency and performance of magnetic coupled DC DC converters.
the efficiency of a magnetically coupled boost DC DC converter is highly dependent of the value of the coupling factor of the magnetic component.

the coupling factor is a critical parameter in the operation of a DC DC converter and its value should be carefully considered in order to optimize the overall energy efficiency of the renewable energy system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the efficiency of the DC DC converter, which is an essential element of the power conditioning system of the distributed renewable energy generator.
the analysis of a specific magnetically DC DC converter for renewable energy systems, in a distributed architecture.
the analysis and the design of the magnetic coupled boost converter, with the coupling factor as a parameter, and the influence of the latter on the energy efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the magnetic coupled boost DC-DC converter with recovery stage is a very good choice for high voltage generation in a distributed renewable energy generator system, and that the coupling factor is a key element to take into account in its design and in the optimization of the global energy efficiency.
the coupling factor has a strong influence on the global behavior of the magnetic coupled converter, especially in the recovery mode.
a magnetically coupled boost DC DC converter is a very efficient converter to be considered in a renewable energy distributed generation system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that a magnetically coupled DC DC converter, dedicated to renewable energy applications, can be modeled using a behavioral approach, and the influence of the magnetizing inductance value, i.e., the coupling factor value, on the converter operation can be deduced.

we have developed an innovative magnetic coupled DC DC boost converter for renewable energy systems, with the aim to increase the energy efficiency and to improve the global performance of the system.

we have shown how to model and simulate the behavior of a specific magnetic coupled DC DC boost converter dedicated to renewable energy applications, in particular for smart grid applications, and how to take into account the coupling factor influence in order to optimize the overall energy efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a magnetic coupled boost DC-DC converter with a recovery circuit can be used to produce high DC voltage in a distributed architecture.
a magnetically coupled converter can be designed in a more efficient way by taking into account the coupling factor value, which can be optimized for a specific application.
the coupling factor has a strong influence on the global energy parameters of the system, and that it should be taken into account when designing such systems.
